learning_outcomes.text: Comprehension of fuel properties, combustion, and combustion systems.
Solve engineering problems with combustion characteristics.
Acquire the skill to use effective communication technologies.
Acquire teamwork and individual work skills.
Acquire Turkish written and oral communication skills.
Acquire awareness of the necessity of lifelong learning.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to combustion technology. Classification of fuels
Refining, Classification of gaseous fuels, Classification of hydrocarbons
Combustion and combustion equations. Ignition temperature, dew point temperature and air properties

H/Y ratio, types of combustion (theoretical complete combustion, complete combustion, incomplete combustion and partial incomplete combustion), stoichiometric air, excess air, excess air percentage, deficient air and deficient air percentage Analysis of combustion products.
Reaction enthalpy and combustion enthalpy. Heating values of fuels. Problem-solving related to combustion products
First law analysis of reaction systems

General reaction equations in terms of characteristic quantities. Calculation of volumetric fractions of products and maximum CO2 Analysis of incomplete combustion and partial incomplete combustion products
Drawing combustion diagrams. Sample problem solving related to drawing combustion diagrams. Concept of equilibrium constant.
Thermal decomposition (dissociation) and its effect on adiabatic flame temperature
Entropy changes of reacting systems Second Law analysis of reacting systems
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan; they are held on dates specified in the academic calendar by decision of the University Senate.
